answer_2.quote: We assess the synthesized speech based on content consistency (Character Error Rate & Word Error Rate, CER/WER), Speaker Similarity (SS), and speech quality (UTMOS, ).

answer_4.quote: we manually validate a subset of hallucination cases through human evaluation of speech-text alignment.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators check whether the generated speech aligns with the target text, identifying hallucinations such as mispronunciations, omissions, or repetitions.
